question: How far does the yoginī named Icchā extend through the siddhas and supreme will?
premises: The yoginī named Icchā is identified
The extent reaches up to māyā by supreme will
inference: The yoginī named Icchā, through the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to māyā.
uncertainties: The precise syntactic relation of siddhaiḥ is somewhat ambiguous.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, with the siddhas, extends up to māyā by supreme will.
